_about: Data for site/burst/. Every number is copied from a receipt; 'source' names it. Pending blocks are null until the Burst release gates are read (docs/burst/PUBLISH_CHECKLIST.md).

board1.source: Arena v3 Board 1 run 2 report (Nagi-ArenaV3-results.md, section 'OUT order per round'), sha256 1ce7c576312505ba36ad78569353e34fb53af339854168ababae19721c3b80d7
board1.design: Realtime, 4 Hz (250 ms ticks), 60 s cap, seed indices 0-9 per game, 3 streams per H100, 0 void rounds. A screen, not a decision.
board1.note: Board 1 screen: realtime, seed indices 0–9 per game, 6 players. Burst here is the Board 1 player whose prompts equal release variant A's. Source: Arena v3 Board 1 report, per-round OUT order; data in data.json.
board1.latency_source: ~/nagi-wt/arena-v3/runs/arena_v3/board1/*_v2/<player>/player_summary.json → per_game.latency_ms.p50 (all requests pooled); sha256 prefixes: t_dual/chord 292f8b72, t_dual/kcall 74ec0153, jev 58c59005, enormous_cl 4c4dc272, enormous_old 61bb139a, semif_4b 017d5b96 (the pins in Burst PREREG §2). The Board 1 report's table uses the median of per-round p50s instead (227/242/249 ms for Burst).
